application.title: Employee Onboarding
application.description: End-to-end candidate onboarding: HR initiation, key-based self-service capture, IOFLOW validation, review and confirmation to employee, with supporting master data, dashboards, reports and a public candidate portal.

navigation.title: Master Data Management
navigation.description: Reference masters driving selection lists, validations and cross-updates across onboarding.
navigation.functional_specs: Group of reference master data transactions used throughout the onboarding process.

navigation.title: Country Master
navigation.description: Maintain countries used for nationality, address and detail-line country codes.
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only master with COUNTRY_CODE, COUNTRY_NAME, ISO_CODE, DIAL_CODE, CURRENCY_CODE, ACTIVE_FLAG. COUNTRY_CODE unique and mandatory; ACTIVE_FLAG defaults to 'Y'. Soft-disable when referenced. Search, Add, Edit, Delete.

navigation.title: Designation & Department Master
navigation.description: Maintain designations, departments, grades, cadres and design codes used by HR.
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only master with DESIGN_CODE, DESIGNATION_NAME, DEPT_CODE, DEPT_NAME, GRADE, GRADE_NAME, CADRE, CADRE_NAME, JOINED_AS, ACTIVE_FLAG. Codes unique within master; DESIGN_CODE mandatory and active to be selectable. Search, Add, Edit, Delete.

navigation.title: Organisation Setup Master
navigation.description: Maintain employment site, payroll site, work shift and holiday table values used at confirmation.
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only master with EMP_SITE, SITE_NAME, PAY_SITE, PAY_SITE_NAME, WORK_SHIFT, SHIFT_NAME, SHIFT_TIMINGS, HOL_TBLNO, HOL_TBL_NAME, ACTIVE_FLAG. Codes unique; only active rows selectable in finalization. Search, Add, Edit, Delete.

navigation.title: Allowance / Deduction (Pay Head) Master
navigation.description: Maintain pay heads referenced by the candidate pay structure (AD_CODE).
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only master with AD_CODE, AD_NAME, AMOUNT_TYPE (Fixed/Percentage/Formula), DEFAULT_FREQUENCY (Monthly/Annual/One-time), RES_FORMULA, APPL_MODE (Earning/Deduction), ACTIVE_FLAG. AD_CODE unique; RES_FORMULA mandatory when AMOUNT_TYPE='Formula'. Search, Add, Edit, Delete.

navigation.title: Qualification Master
navigation.description: Maintain qualification codes/types used in candidate education detail.
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only master with QLF_CODE, QLF_NAME, QLF_TYPE (Academic/Professional/Certification), COURSE_TYPE (Full-time/Part-time/Distance), ACTIVE_FLAG. QLF_CODE unique; QLF_TYPE mandatory. Search, Add, Edit, Delete.

navigation.title: Demographic Reference Master
navigation.description: Maintain lookup values for Religion, Caste, Blood Group, Marital Status, Name Prefix, Mother Tongue, Nationality and Relation.
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only master with LOOKUP_TYPE, LOOKUP_CODE, LOOKUP_DESC, ACTIVE_FLAG. (LOOKUP_TYPE, LOOKUP_CODE) unique; only active values appear in candidate drop-downs. Search, Add, Edit, Delete.

navigation.title: Onboarding Configuration
navigation.description: System parameters controlling link generation, key behaviour and integration endpoints.
navigation.functional_specs: Group for onboarding system configuration.

navigation.title: Onboarding Settings
navigation.description: Single-record configuration governing access-key life, retry limits and IOFLOW connectivity.
navigation.functional_specs: Single-record/effective-dated config: KEY_VALIDITY_DAYS (default 1), MAX_VALIDATION_ATTEMPTS (default 3), IOFLOW_BASE_URL, IOFLOW_PAN_ENDPOINT, IOFLOW_AADHAR_ENDPOINT, IOFLOW_BANK_ENDPOINT, IOFLOW_EMPLOYEE_ENDPOINT, IOFLOW_AUTH_TOKEN, HR_NOTIFY_EMAIL_TEMPLATE, CANDIDATE_SUBMIT_EMAIL_TEMPLATE. Validations: KEY_VALIDITY_DAYS>0, MAX_VALIDATION_ATTEMPTS 1-10, URLs mandatory and well-formed. Exposes project variables :key_validity_days and :max_validation_attempts (declared under Variables panel). Edit (Save) only; no delete.

navigation.title: Candidate Onboarding Management
navigation.description: HR-facing master transaction covering the full candidate onboarding lifecycle.
navigation.functional_specs: Group for the candidate onboarding record and its lifecycle actions.

navigation.title: Candidate Onboarding Record
navigation.description: HR creates and manages candidate onboarding from initial capture through submission, review and confirmation as employee.
navigation.functional_specs: Header + four detail tables (Past Experience, Educational Qualification, Family, Candidate Pay). STATUS lifecycle Link Generated -> Link Accessed -> DataSubmitted -> Review -> Confirmed with STATUS_DATE stamped on each transition. Header fields: HR capture (CANDIDATE_ID, CANDIDATE_NAME, GENDER, COUNTRY_CODE, DESIGN_CODE, EMAIL_ID, STATUS, STATUS_DATE, INITIATED_BY, INITIATED_ON), access key (ACCESS_KEY, KEY_GENERATED_ON, KEY_EXPIRY_DATETIME, KEY_VALID_FLAG, FORM_URL, LINK_SENT_ON, LINK_ACCESSED_ON, SUBMITTED_ON), candidate personal/contact/statutory/financial, validation status (PAN/AADHAR/BANK *_VALIDATED, *_VALIDATED_NAME, *_ATTEMPTS), attachments (PAN_DOC, AADHAR_DOC, BANK_DOC), HR finalization (EMP_CODE, DESIGNATION, DEPT_CODE, GRADE, CADRE, DESIGN_CODE, REPORT_TO, JOINED_AS, DATE_JOIN, WORK_SHIFT, HOL_TBLNO, EMP_SITE, PAY_SITE, BASIC, GROSS, PROBATION_DATE, PROBATION_PRD, NOTICE_PRD, EMAIL_ID_OFF, REPORT_TO__ADMIN, USER_ID, REMARKS, EMPLOYEE_PUSHED_FLAG, EMPLOYEE_PUSH_REF). Field validations: PAN AAAAA9999A, AADHAR 12 digits, IFSC 11-char, MOBILE 10 digits, PIN 6 digits, valid emails; validation attempts capped at :max_validation_attempts; KEY_EXPIRY_DATETIME = KEY_GENERATED_ON + :key_validity_days; EMP_CODE unique & DATE_JOIN mandatory & GROSS>=BASIC before Confirm; Confirm only when STATUS=Review. Actions: Search, List Recent, Add (Initiate Candidate), Edit, Delete (only while Link Generated and not accessed), Send/Resend Link, Re-validate PAN/AADHAR/Bank (IOFLOW), Review, Confirm (Push to IOFLOW Employee), Cancel. Triggers: send-email candidate link on Send Link, IOFLOW validation on Re-validate, set STATUS=Review on Review, IOFLOW Employee-creation API + store EMPLOYEE_PUSHED_FLAG/EMPLOYEE_PUSH_REF + send-notification to HR on Confirm, set STATUS=DataSubmitted + invalidate key + notify on candidate Submit.

navigation.title: Reports & Visuals
navigation.description: Onboarding analytics, tracking grids and printable candidate data sheet.
navigation.functional_specs: Group of visuals and reports for onboarding monitoring and documentation.

navigation.title: Onboarding Pipeline by Status
navigation.description: Count of candidates per STATUS per period.
navigation.functional_specs: Stacked-Column-Chart. Criteria: date range (INITIATED_ON), DESIGN_CODE, COUNTRY_CODE. Data: count of candidates per STATUS per period. Drill-down: click segment -> filtered candidate list.

navigation.title: Candidate Status Distribution
navigation.description: STATUS vs candidate count.
navigation.functional_specs: Pie-Chart / Doughnut-Chart. Criteria: date range. Data: STATUS vs candidate count.

navigation.title: Onboarding Tracker
navigation.description: Candidate-wise current status with hyperlink to the record.
navigation.functional_specs: Grid. Criteria: STATUS, INITIATED_BY, date range, DESIGNATION. Data: CANDIDATE_NAME, EMAIL_ID, DESIGNATION, STATUS, STATUS_DATE, LINK_SENT_ON, LINK_ACCESSED_ON, SUBMITTED_ON, KEY_EXPIRY_DATETIME, INITIATED_BY. Hyperlink CANDIDATE_NAME -> Candidate Onboarding Record.

navigation.title: Expired / Pending Links
navigation.description: Links awaiting candidate action with expiry highlighting.
navigation.functional_specs: Grid. Criteria: status in (Link Generated, Link Accessed). Data: CANDIDATE_NAME, EMAIL_ID, LINK_SENT_ON, KEY_EXPIRY_DATETIME, days pending, STATUS. Conditional highlight for keys past expiry.

navigation.title: Validation Outcome Summary
navigation.description: PAN/AADHAR/BANK validated vs failed vs attempts-exhausted.
navigation.functional_specs: Grid / Column-Chart. Criteria: date range. Data: counts of PAN/AADHAR/BANK validated vs failed vs attempts-exhausted.

navigation.title: Onboarding Aging
navigation.description: Average days in each status / candidate-wise aging buckets.
navigation.functional_specs: Bar-Chart. Criteria: status. Data: average days in each status / candidate-wise aging buckets.

navigation.title: Candidate Profile Data Sheet
navigation.description: Pixel-perfect printable consolidation of a candidate for the personnel file.
navigation.functional_specs: Jasper document report. Criteria: CANDIDATE_ID. Header (company logo + title), candidate photo block, signature block, page breaks between sections. Grouping: (1) Personal & Contact, (2) Statutory & Bank with validation status, (3) Past Experience, (4) Educational Qualification, (5) Family, (6) Employment & Pay Structure. Pay Structure sub-totals of earnings, deductions and net (GROSS). All header fields plus four detail tables.

navigation.title: HR Onboarding Dashboard
navigation.description: Consolidated onboarding metrics and visuals for HR / Onboarding Coordinator.
navigation.functional_specs: Dashboard for HR / Onboarding Coordinator. Criteria with defaults: date range (default current month on INITIATED_ON), DESIGN_CODE (All), INITIATED_BY (current user), STATUS (All). Cards: Total Candidates Initiated, Links Pending Action, Data Submitted (awaiting review), Confirmed this period, Expired Links. Visuals: Onboarding Pipeline by Status (Stacked-Column), Candidate Status Distribution (Doughnut), Onboarding Tracker (Grid with hyperlink), Validation Outcome Summary (Column-Chart), Onboarding Aging (Bar-Chart).

navigation.title: Header

navigation.functional_specs: External chrome footer: copyright line, privacy/data-use note, contact line (HR email/phone), optional secondary link group (Privacy, Terms).

navigation.title: Candidate Onboarding Form
navigation.description: Public, key-validated intake form the candidate opens from the emailed link.
navigation.functional_specs: External anonymous Smart Page reached at /onboard?key=<ACCESS_KEY>. Key-validation gate via GET /api/onboard/validate-key: if invalid/expired/already-submitted render callout and hide inputs; on first successful open set STATUS=Link Accessed and stamp LINK_ACCESSED_ON. Hero with branding and candidate name. Sections: Personal Details (NAME_PREFIX, EMP_FNAME, EMP_MNAME, EMP_LNAME, GENDER, BIRTHDATE, NATIONALITY, MARITAL_STATUS, MARRIAGE_ANNIVERSARY, BLOOD_GROUP, RELIGION, CAST_CATEGORY, MOTHER_TONGUE, PHYSICAL_HANDICAP, HOBBY1, HOBBY2, TOTAL_EXPERIENCE); Address & Contact (current/permanent address, MOBILE, ALTERNATE_TELEPHONE, emergency contact, optional same-as-current copy); Statutory & Financial with inline Validate PAN/Aadhaar/Bank buttons showing validated status, returned name and remaining attempts; Document upload (PAN_DOC, AADHAR_DOC, BANK_DOC); repeater grids for Past Experience, Educational Qualification, Family. Actions/CTAs: Validate PAN/Aadhaar/Bank (POST /api/onboard/validate/{type}), Upload (POST /api/onboard/upload), Save draft (POST /api/onboard/save, keeps editable), Submit (POST /api/onboard/submit -> final validation, lock, STATUS=DataSubmitted, email candidate summary, notify HR). Validation capped at :max_validation_attempts; attachments image/PDF with size limit; BANK_DOC must be cancelled cheque/passbook. Loads via GET /api/onboard/draft and master lookups /api/masters/countries, /api/masters/qualifications, /api/masters/lookups.

navigation.title: Onboarding Confirmation
navigation.description: Thank-you page shown to the candidate after Submit.
navigation.functional_specs: External anonymous Smart Page. Hero confirmation banner, callout summarizing details received and a copy emailed, contact-HR line. No inputs.

navigation.title: Invalid / Expired Link
navigation.description: Page explaining the onboarding link is no longer valid.
navigation.functional_specs: External anonymous Smart Page. Hero + callout explaining the link is expired/invalid/already submitted and to contact HR. No inputs.
